records.title: 毕业离校
records.notes: Viewed full resolution: eyes align toward the same off-camera point; glasses clear; campus portrait identity and framing retained. Phone crop still to check.

records.title: 新的课堂
records.notes: Rear-side classroom view shows listening and note-taking; no frontal gaze defect; ordinary clothes, desks and projector fit university years.

records.title: 宿舍里的夜读
records.notes: Black window and practical lamp establish night; gaze falls onto pages, hands and old laptop read coherently.

records.title: 课本以外的讨论
records.notes: Three distinct classmates converse outdoors; main gaze follows the woman, gesture and papers support discussion; no solo-desk substitution.

records.title: 收起四年前的行李
records.notes: Side-back packing action puts books into backpack; dorm bed and desk persist, summer shirt and foliage fit departure.

records.title: 手机里的产品讨论
records.notes: Hands, early smartphone and paper wireframes support a product discussion without another central portrait.

records.title: 核对这一项
records.notes: Gray sleeve, pen and colleague pointing hand support checking a specific item in the same meeting.

records.title: 开始新的项目
records.notes: Adult lead hands papers to a colleague while another works; new workspace and action distinguish commitment from pre-choice pose.

records.title: 运转起来的团队
records.notes: Wider office with distinct staff at separate desks shows project operation rather than repeating the lead portrait.

records.title: 见面还没有发生
records.notes: Side-back lead at window; closed laptop and phone on desk support waiting; no smile or event reenactment.

records.title: 面对公开消息
records.notes: Neutral adult looking down at laptop; no smiling interview, courtroom or invented alleged conduct.

records.title: 把问题问清楚
records.notes: Young adult and older colleague talk across returned work; clear eyeline and distinct characters.

records.title: 先重写一版
records.notes: Pen actively rewrites work on a separate sheet; sleeve, laptop and papers preserve office continuity.

records.title: 下班回到家
records.notes: Night interior arrival; bag is being put down, coat carried; manuscript not yet being read.

records.title: 又拿起了笔
records.notes: Literal pen returning to old manuscript; black knit, lamp and night window continue home scene; hands coherent.

records.title: 重新写开头
records.notes: Crossed-out old opening and fresh writing show revision; night lamp and sleeve continue choice scene.

records.title: 今晚先收起来
records.notes: Clipped manuscript and note with pen put down show stopping for the evening; no writing hand.

records.title: 有人等你继续
records.notes: Reverse angle of distinct bookshop listeners looking toward reader; shoulder/pages anchor eyeline and location.

records.title: 顺着一条注释
records.notes: Finger follows a footnote among photocopies near shelves; no face; ordinary research materials rather than forged source.

records.title: 把问题写具体
records.notes: Hand rewrites a concrete research outline beside crossed-out notes; library materials and sleeve match.

records.title: 慢慢查，慢慢写
records.notes: Wide library work scene gives time and space; lead small in frame actively taking notes.

records.title: 认真回信，再核一次
records.notes: Reply sheet at side and pen following open reference page show checking after reply; bright library consistent.

records.title: 划清这次的范围
records.notes: Blue sleeve hand crosses out scope on meeting paper, colleague anchors page; literal changed plan.

records.title: 先听对方怎么说
records.notes: Reverse meeting angle retains blue-shirt lead, female colleague and bald colleague; another person explains while lead listens.

records.title: 把该交的部分交出去
records.notes: Folder passes between lead and colleague in same office; real handover replaces blocked meeting.

records.title: 会议结束，把本子合上
records.notes: Black sleeve hand closes notebook with pen beside it; empty chairs support final quiet beat.

records.title: 先做好最常用的功能
records.notes: Pen visibly crosses out most tasks next to face-down older phone; hands coherent and action distinct.

records.title: 秋天的脚步
records.notes: Version 2 inspected: gray sneakers and white soles now match wider next shot, with same dark trousers and gray top; natural forward step.

records.title: 读者来了一封信
records.notes: Upright reading pose with both hands on letter and natural downward eyeline; no reused head-on-hand composition.

records.title: 这一版，先做什么
records.notes: Neutral table before decision; two unmodified sketches, face-down older phone and laid-down pen do not pre-perform either choice.

records.title: 听听用户怎么说
records.notes: Phone held naturally during listening; adult side gaze coherent, black shirt and older phone fit 2017 office discussion.

records.title: 几年里，产品改了又改
records.notes: Small team at separate workstations before receiving feedback; lead gaze down at work, no premature group celebration.

records.title: 圈出这一次要交的部分
records.notes: Hoodie sleeve and pen circle a limited part of the work diagram; coherent hands and colleague edge preserve discussion.

records.title: 听完同事的想法
records.notes: Lead rests hands on chair while colleague explains; no pointing before listening. Gaze directed toward colleague.

records.title: 再往前走一小段
records.notes: Wide rear walking shot shows continuing along autumn park path; gray sneakers and sweatshirt visible, no backward portrait gaze.

records.title: 起身，去下一场
records.notes: Adult stands and moves chair back in same backstage setting; side-back view and corridor support departure, eyes coherent.

records.title: 把旧稿装进信封
records.notes: Blue-white school sleeves and both hands pack three manuscript sections into kraft envelope on established wooden desk; no repeated reading portrait.

records.title: 看到这条反馈
records.notes: Version 2 inspected: ordinary wide top notch replaces later pill hardware; blurred messages, hand grip and table preserved for 2021 feedback detail.

note: 生成重构，不是历史原照。退选的新版手机和不连续的鞋子已修订；实体手机尚未测试。
